usage: Used for an official document that proves something is true, such as ownership, training, or quality.
Very common in shopping and jewellery contexts when checking whether an item comes with proof of authenticity or grade.
Can be used with verbs like have, get, show, bring, or keep, depending on the situation.
Learners should treat it as a countable noun in English sense; in Cantonese it often sounds natural in formal or practical contexts.
